text:
```yaml
name: Extension Publish Marketplace

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci

    - name: Run markdown linting
      run: npm run lint:md

    - name: Run spell checking
      run: npm run spell-check

    - name: Run frontmatter validation
      run: npm run lint:frontmatter

    - name: Run skill structure validation
      run: npm run validate:skills

    - name: Run link validation
      run: npm run lint:md-links

    - name: Run PowerShell analysis
      run: npm run lint:ps

    - name: Generate plugins
      run: npm run plugin:generate

    - name: Commit changes
      run: |
        git add .
        git commit -m "chore(microsoft/hve-core): update broken file directives and markdown links after collection directory reorg"
        git push origin main
```
